skills.name: Properties of regular polygons and parallelograms

note.text:
Parallelogram: opposite sides are parallel and equal; opposite angles are equal; two angles next to each other add up to 180°; the diagonals cut each other in half (they bisect each other).
Special parallelograms: rectangle (four right angles, equal diagonals), rhombus (four equal sides, diagonals perpendicular), square (both).
Regular polygon with n sides: each exterior angle = 360° ÷ n; each interior angle = 180° − exterior angle; it has n lines of symmetry.

worked_example.problem: In parallelogram ABCD, Â = {a}°. Find B̂, Ĉ and D̂.
steps: Next to each other: B̂ = {180} − {a} = {180 - a}°.
Opposite angles are equal: Ĉ = {a}°, D̂ = {180 - a}°.

cards.idea: In a parallelogram, two angles next to each other add up to {180}°.
Opposite angles of a parallelogram are equal; opposite sides too.
example: Â = Ĉ, B̂ = D̂, AB = DC

cards.idea: The diagonals of a parallelogram cut each other in half.

check.prompt: The diagonals of parallelogram ABCD meet at O. AC = {d} cm. Find AO.

misconceptions.explain: O is the midpoint: AO is half of AC.

solution: The diagonals bisect each other: O is the midpoint of [AC].

questions.prompt: In parallelogram ABCD, Â = {a}°. Find B̂.

misconceptions.explain: Â and B̂ are next to each other: they add up to {180}°. Only opposite angles are equal.

solution: Â and B̂ are next to each other.

questions.prompt: In parallelogram ABCD, B̂ = {a}°. Find D̂.

misconceptions.explain: B̂ and D̂ are opposite, not next to each other: they are equal.

solution: B̂ and D̂ are opposite angles.

questions.prompt: The diagonals of parallelogram ABCD meet at O. AC = {d} cm. Find AO.

misconceptions.explain: O is the midpoint: AO is half of AC.

solution: The diagonals bisect each other: O is the midpoint of [AC].

right.text: The opposite sides of a parallelogram are equal.
The diagonals of a rhombus are perpendicular.
A regular hexagon has six lines of symmetry.

wrong.text: All the angles of a parallelogram are equal.
wrong.explain: Only opposite angles are equal; angles next to each other add up to 180°.

wrong.text: The diagonals of every parallelogram are equal.
wrong.explain: Only a rectangle (or a square) has equal diagonals.

wrong.text: A regular pentagon has ten lines of symmetry.
wrong.explain: A regular polygon with n sides has n lines of symmetry: five.
